payload.text: (hv, 2026-11-24, two answers in this order) THE COURSE TEACHES THE FULL 8 HEX IN AC AND AT LABELS. First, in vc's question dialog, hv chose "Yes, add it to this batch" (a 4-hex package prefix in labels). Then, in devbin-vc's window by AskUserQuestion, after vc put the conflict with PLAN.md D1 (hv's word at 11:45Z) to hv, hv chose "No prefix, D1 stands"; relayed by devbin-vc, not heard first-hand by vc. The second answer replaces the first. Corrected forward the same day on a fact found after it: the prefix door already ships in 3.5.2 by design (Facade::whole_label completes a unique 4-hex package prefix and stores the label whole). Option (a), keep the door as shipped with no code change and teach the 8 hex, is devbin-vc's call and vc's recommendation, and hv was told; it is not yet hv's own ruling, and hv may still choose to remove the door.
